ngaap.guidance: Q1-26: core revenue growth +low-single digits (Biotechnology +high-single digit, Life Sciences flat/-low-single digit, Diagnostics -low-single digit); FX ~+3.5% on sales; corporate expense ~$(90)m; net interest expense ~$(45)m; tax rate ~17.0%; average adjusted diluted shares ~714.0m. FY2026: core revenue growth +3.0% to +6.0% (Biotechnology ~+6.0%, Life Sciences flat, Diagnostics +low-single digit); adjusted diluted EPS initiated at $8.35-$8.50; adjusted operating profit margin ~28.5%; FX ~+1.0% on sales; amortization ~$1.7bn; corporate expense ~$(360)m; net interest expense ~$(180)m; tax rate ~17.0%; average adjusted diluted shares ~717.0m (rates as of 31-Dec-2025).
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value gains/losses on equity & LP investments, impairments, product-line disposition gains, significant acquisition-related items and discrete tax items; no MCPS. Item amounts from release footnotes. From Q4-25 the measures are labelled 'from continuing operations' ($14m discontinued-ops tax benefit excluded). Gain on sale of a facility ($11m) is not among the segment 'Other Operating Profit Adjustments' (total 4 = 14 − 10), so treated as nonop. adj_op_pub 1,934 = OP 1,502 + amortization 428 + other adjustments 4 (release segment table; FY25 6,939). Adjusted OP margin not published for the quarter (computed 28.3%); GAAP OP margin 22.0%. Release also gives core operating margin change (non-GAAP) of (1.15)pt for Q4-25.
